(()=>{const rect=r=>({x:r.x,y:r.y,width:r.width,height:r.height,right:r.right,bottom:r.bottom}),dock=document.querySelector('[aria-label="Model navigation"]');if(!dock)throw Error('Model navigation absent');const all=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.building-control-dock button,.draftsman-control-dock button,.draftsman-control-dock select,.live-assistant-launcher'));const result=[];for(const b of all){if(!b.getClientRects().length)continue;b.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest',inline:'nearest',behavior:'instant'});const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width<43.9||r.height<43.9)throw Error('Small target '+(b.ariaLabel||b.textContent));if(r.x<0||r.right>innerWidth||r.y<0||r.bottom>innerHeight||!b.contains(document.elementFromPoint(r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2)))throw Error('Blocked control '+(b.ariaLabel||b.textContent));result.push({name:b.ariaLabel||b.textContent.trim(),...rect(r)});}const draft=document.querySelector('.draftsman-control-dock'),top=document.querySelector('[aria-label="3D view controls"]');if(draft&&top){const dr=draft.getBoundingClientRect(),tr=top.getBoundingClientRect();if(dr.left<tr.right&&dr.right>tr.left&&dr.top<tr.bottom&&dr.bottom>tr.top)throw Error('Drafting dock overlaps original top settings: '+JSON.stringify({draft:rect(dr),top:rect(tr)}));}return {viewport:[innerWidth,innerHeight],controls:result,navigation:rect(dock.getBoundingClientRect())};})()
